}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] finely-[[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]] or any type of cooking [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|oil]]
*3 cloves of [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] [[Cookbook:Muskrat|muskrat meat]], cut into pieces 
*2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*½ tsp black [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Wine|red wine]]
*5–8 leaves of [[Cookbook:Collard Greens|collard greens]], cut into pieces 
*1 cup brown [[Cookbook:Lentil|lentils]]
*3 medium [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* Red and yellow [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]], diced
*1 [[Cookbook:Jalapeño|jalapeño]] for heat (optional), diced
*3 cups [[Cookbook:Stock|vegetable stock]]
*2 cups [[Cookbook:Water|water]] (1 cup for constantly [[Cookbook:Deglazing|deglazing]] the pan)
*½ tsp [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]

==Procedure==
#Add the onion in to a large pot, and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] until golden-brown. Then, add the olive oil in and stir constantly. 
#After a couple of minutes, add the garlic. You can add a little bit of water to prevent the garlic from burning.
#Add the muskrat meat and stir until golden brown. Stir in the tomato paste.
#After 5 minutes later, add the salt and pepper and taste the mixture. 
#Add the brown lentils and cook for 5–7 minutes.
#Add the collard greens and cook for 3–4 minutes.
# [[Cookbook:Deglazing|Deglaze]] the pot with the red wine and cook until reduced by half. 
# Add the diced potatoes, and stir for 5 more minutes. 
# Add the vegetable stock and the water that is left. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. 
#Add the peppers with the jalapeño. Let the soup [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for at least 10 minutes and add the rosemary.
#Turn off the heat. You can serve it right away or wait 10 minutes before serving. Enjoy the soup!

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Soak the muskrat meat in salt water overnight to reduce the gamey taste.
* You can boil the lentils separately to save time and just add them right at the end before you add the peppers.
